method: getComputedStyle on a KEYBOARD-focused task row in each app, read twice ~500ms apart to confirm the value had settled (meologue's row controls animate their ring in, so an immediate read catches mid-transition values).

todoist.focusedRow: Buy mobile holder and get the bike fixed

verdict.outline: AGREES in substance. Both report outlineStyle: none, so neither draws an outline. The shorthand differs only in the width component of an outline that is not rendered (0px in Todoist, 3px in meologue) — not a visible difference, and recorded here so a future reader does not mistake the string mismatch for one.
verdict.note: THEME-03's other two values (borders rgb(61,61,61), muted text rgb(204,204,204)) were already identical in both and were not re-read this flow; only the focus ring was in question.
